decisions.reason: The single-tube air fin cooler remains core to the heat exchange portfolio for process and energy customers and costs little to keep on offer.
Air cooled condensers are a standard offering for power and refrigeration customers and use the firm's established manufacturing base.
Although it overlaps with Product B, a growing firm is likely to keep both condenser variants for different applications rather than consolidate them now.
Liners for corroded tubes support the high-margin lifecycle repair business that is central to the firm's service strategy.
A customized air cooler line with several models fits the firm's integrated, tailored solutions approach and serves many customer segments.
Tube end repair inserts strengthen the spare parts and repair offering at low ongoing cost and extend equipment life.
